title: Headless Commerce API: Admin Setup for Your Own Storefront, App or Integration | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The CrestApps commerce API lets your own storefront, a phone app, a point of sale or a back-office system sell from the same products, prices, carts and stock as your Orchard Core store. This video shows what you set up in the admin so it can work: the API features, the OpenAPI explorers (Swagger UI, Scalar UI and ReDoc UI), the anonymous schema setting, the OpenID sign-in server, public and confidential applications, and a CORS policy for a storefront on another address.

In this video:
• Why a commerce API, and how features, explorers, sign-in and CORS fit together
• Turning on the API features
• OpenAPI and its explorers, and anonymous access to the schema
• The OpenID sign-in server: endpoints, flows and token validation
• A public app for buyers, and a confidential application for a server
• A CORS policy for a storefront on another address
• Who can do what, and what the API cannot do
• Use cases
